note: Jefferson County Conservation park, 254 acres on the SW edge of Fairfield, with two campgrounds about 600 m apart: the lower one in timber, and Prairie Ridge on open ground off Key Blvd, for self-contained rigs. Two camping cabins. Nature center, 7 mi of trails, 75-ft swinging bridge. --Claude
